text:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: deploy-2719 failed canary healthchecks in eu-west-2 — 45% of canaries reporting 429s, latency up 2x. Auto-pager invoked. thread_ts=2770012345

oncall-ryan: saw the alert, waking up. any customer-facing errors?

maria-sre: dashboards show spike in ratelimit responses from rate-limiter v2.0.3 rolled at 2770012000. Many requests showing missing exemption tags.

eng-anna: I pushed that config, petty change to exemptions mapping. Rolling back now if needed. Can someone dump a sample token header?

infra-sam: `curl -I https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer tok_ABC123"` -> `X-Rate-Exempt: ` (empty). Should be `X-Rate-Exempt: user-tier:enterprise` for some routes.

customer-success-lee: getting 3 customers reporting elevated 429s and stalled jobs. Ticket queue already showing CNX-1023, PLT-1105. High-touch customers flagged.

ops-bot: Incident severity: P1. Paging on-call: @oncall-ryan. Suggested mitigation: flip feature flag `rlv2-mapping` to previous.

oncall-ryan: on it. Flipping flag now to rollback mapping. `# infra deploy-flags flip rlv2-mapping=false --env=eu-west-2`

deploy-bot: Flag flip request queued. Rolling flip across EU region. Progress: 0/6 -> 3/6 -> 6/6.

maria-sre: quick note: there are also token-accounting diffs in the access logs where the token counter increments twice for some proxy paths — could amplify quotas. Not sure if config change touched counting hooks.

eng-anna: confirming: my PR made a small rename in headers map and a couple of placeholder keys. I did not intend to touch token accounting but see the code path shares the header parsing util. investigating.

infra-sam: Mitigation status: flag flip to old mapper completed in 2m. Rate-limiter metrics starting to trend down but still ~10% over baseline.

customer-success-lee: replied to customers: "we're rolling back a config change, ETA 5-10m, will follow-up" — they want ETA and impact summary.

oncall-ryan: Can we do an emergency rollback of deploy-2719 while we diagnose the double-count? If flag flip doesn't normalize within 10m, we'll rollback.

eng-anna: I can trigger rollback: `deployctl rollback --release 2719 --reason "canary 429s / exemptions mapping"`

ops-bot: Rollback initiated by eng-anna. Gate checks: schema migration? none. Estimated downtime: none.

deploy-bot: Rollback progress: starting pods termination -> image revert -> config apply.

maria-sre: After rollback start, I'm seeing token accounting error traces in logs pointing to `header_parser.go:87` where `X-Rate-Exempt` sanitized to empty and `accounting.Record()` called twice on retry path. Posting snippet:

```
2026-03-15T02:05:12Z [WARN] header_parser.go:87 empty exemption header
2026-03-15T02:05:12Z [ERROR] accounting.go:213 double-record on request id=req-9a8f
```

infra-sam: Looks like the change added a `.Normalize()` that strips unknown attributes — it removed `enterprise` tag when it didn't match new enum. That caused exemptions to be lost, and retries recorded again. Bad combo.

customer-success-lee: two customers just acknowledged reduced 429s after the flag flip, but still waiting on full rollback confirmation. They're asking for an incident summary once stable.

oncall-ryan: Rollback finished across EU in ~4m. Metrics: 429s down to 3% above baseline, pre-deploy baseline within 12m post-rollback. No observed increase in latency.

eng-anna: I've reverted my PR in upstream and opened hotfix PR to decouple header normalization from accounting path. Will push a patch to prevent double-record.

maria-sre: Let's keep the on-call rotation for 1hr watch. I'll trigger a synthetic load test against quota-sensitive routes to validate.

ops-bot: Synthetic test started: `siege -c 200 -t 2M https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate` against eu-west-2. Expecting steady 200 responses.

infra-sam: Test: 200s 98.3%, 429s 1.7% (within tolerated noise). No double-record traces after rollback.

eng-anna: hotfix PR created: `#3321` - patch removes normalization side-effect and adds unit tests for accounting hooks. Requesting expedited review.

pm-jordan: flagging follow-up actions for postmortem: 1) require header regex whitelist tests in deploy pipelines; 2) decouple parsing util from accounting; 3) add canary synthetic smoke that exercises exemptions; 4) customer comms template.

customer-success-lee: I'll prepare customer communications and follow up with impacted accounts with a brief timeline and workaround notes.

oncall-ryan: summary for pager: cause = header normalization in mapping change removed exemption tags -> rate-limiter treated enterprise customers as normal -> over-throttling 429s + accounting double-count due to retry path -> mitigation = feature-flag flip -> rollback release 2719 -> status = stabilized, continue 1hr watch -> owners: eng-anna (fix), maria-sre (monitoring), infra-sam (rollback/runbooks), cs-lee (customer comms).

deploy-bot: Incident closed from active pager after stabilization. Postmortem owner assigned: eng-anna. Please file full postmortem doc in /incidents/postmortems within 48h. :white_check_mark:
